algorithms.name: Sieve of Eratosthenes up to n
algorithms.explanation: Each prime p crosses out n/p numbers, and the sum of 1/p over the primes up to n is about log log n.

es.explanation: Cada primo p tacha n/p números, y la suma de 1/p sobre los primos hasta n es aproximadamente log log n.

algorithms.name: Primality test by trial division
algorithms.explanation: A composite n has a divisor ≤ √n, so that's as far as you need to try.

es.explanation: Un n compuesto tiene un divisor ≤ √n, así que no hace falta probar más allá.

algorithms.name: Euclid's algorithm for gcd(a, b)
algorithms.explanation: Every two steps, the smaller number at least halves.

es.explanation: Cada dos pasos, el número más chico se reduce al menos a la mitad.

algorithms.name: a^b mod m by repeated squaring
algorithms.explanation: One squaring (and at most one extra multiplication) per bit of b.

es.explanation: Una elevación al cuadrado (y a lo sumo una multiplicación extra) por cada bit de b.

algorithms.name: Factoring one number with a precomputed smallest-prime-factor sieve
algorithms.explanation: Each step divides by a prime ≥ 2, so there are at most log₂ n steps.

es.explanation: Cada paso divide por un primo ≥ 2, así que hay a lo sumo log₂ n pasos.

algorithms.name: Divisor counts of every number up to n, looping over the multiples of each d
algorithms.explanation: Each d visits n/d multiples, and the sum of n/d is n times the harmonic series.

es.explanation: Cada d visita n/d múltiplos, y la suma de n/d es n por la serie armónica.

algorithms.name: Extended Euclid (x, y with ax + by = gcd(a, b))
algorithms.explanation: The same steps as Euclid's algorithm, plus O(1) work per step to carry the coefficients back.

es.explanation: Los mismos pasos que el algoritmo de Euclides, más O(1) de trabajo por paso para arrastrar los coeficientes.

algorithms.name: q queries of C(n, k) mod p with n ≤ N, after precomputing factorials and inverse factorials
algorithms.explanation: The tables take O(N) to fill (one modular inverse, then going backwards); each query is two multiplications.

es.explanation: Llenar las tablas cuesta O(N) (un inverso modular y después hacia atrás); cada consulta son dos multiplicaciones.

algorithms.name: Deterministic Miller–Rabin with k fixed bases
algorithms.explanation: Each base costs one modular exponentiation, which is O(log n) multiplications.

es.explanation: Cada base cuesta una exponenciación modular, que son O(log n) multiplicaciones.

algorithms.name: Counting numbers ≤ n divisible by at least one of k primes, by inclusion–exclusion
algorithms.explanation: 2ᵏ subsets of the primes, each multiplying up to k of them; n only appears inside the division.

es.explanation: 2ᵏ subconjuntos de primos, y cada uno multiplica hasta k de ellos; n solo aparece dentro de la división.
